name: Lapidoth Capital Ltd
summary: Lapidoth Capital Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages construction and infrastructure contracting activities. The company is also involved in development and construction of projects in the residential construction and rental apartment; and import of cellular devices, tablets, smart watches and accessories. In addition, it undertakes construction of various complex projects, such as national infrastructure, commercial centers and offices, government buildings, airports, and hospitals, as well as industrial buildings; and paving roads, laying railroad tracks, bridges, parking lots and digging tunnels for public clients.
